categories.main_business_segments: Ropeok Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the AI technology sector, providing AI-enabled digital economy solutions and products. Its main business segments include AI+Public Safety, AI+Social Governance, AI+Transportation, AI+Cultural Tourism, AI+Education, AI+Healthcare and Elderly Care, AI+Urban Emergency, AI+Digital Ocean, AI+Agricultural Ecology, and AI+Industrial Manufacturing. The company offers integrated system solutions, intelligent hardware products, and data services across these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core AI technologies such as computer vision, multi-modal data perception, edge computing, big data analytics, semantic analysis, machine learning, and intelligent integration. It has developed an AI unified platform (RUP), AIoT technology platform, big data platform, and intelligent hardware technology platform. Key technological focuses include AI large models, multi-modal semantic recognition, AIoT integration, and domestic substitution of core technologies. The company employs advanced manufacturing and development methods including agile and integrated product development (IPD) models, and maintains certifications like CMMI Level 5 and ITSS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ropeok serves primarily government agencies such as public security bureaus, judicial and law enforcement bodies, traffic management, education, healthcare, and municipal services. It also targets industries like cultural tourism, digital ocean economy, agriculture, industrial manufacturing, and emergency management. The company’s solutions cater to public safety, social governance, smart city infrastructure, and vertical industry digital transformation needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a focus on regions including East China, South China, Central China, Northeast, North China, Southwest, and Northwest. It has established subsidiaries and innovation bases in multiple provinces and cities such as Xiamen, Shanghai, Chongqing, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and others. The company is also exploring overseas markets and preparing for international business expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ropeok operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI technology supply chain. It develops core AI algorithms, software platforms, and intelligent hardware products, and provides integrated system solutions and services to end customers. The company also engages in data services and ecosystem collaboration, positioning itself as a technology enabler and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities focus on advancing AI core technologies including AI large models, multi-modal fusion, edge computing, and AIoT integration. It emphasizes innovation in AI-enabled industry applications, data governance, and secure, compliant AI solutions. Ropeok invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and pursues product commercialization in vertical sectors such as public safety, smart cities, digital ocean, and industrial manufacturing. It also aims to build an open AI ecosystem and accelerate AI technology adoption across industries.
categories.revenue_model: Ropeok generates revenue primarily through sales of AI-enabled system solutions, intelligent hardware products, and maintenance and other related services. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance for product sales, and on a time-proportion basis for maintenance services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. It operates mainly on a direct sales model supported by regional subsidiaries and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading AI technology and solution provider in China’s AI and digital economy sectors, particularly in public safety and smart city applications. It competes with domestic and international AI firms, including major cloud and chip providers like Huawei, NVIDIA, and Cambricon, especially in AI computing and algorithm domains. Ropeok differentiates itself through deep industry expertise, integrated AI+industry solutions, and a broad ecosystem of academic and industrial collaborations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ropeok reported total revenue of approximately RMB 142.96 million, a 68.08% decrease from the previous year, reflecting market and macroeconomic challenges. The company incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 193.23 million, with total assets of RMB 1.52 billion and shareholders’ equity of RMB 892 million. Despite the decline, the company maintains significant R&D investment (19.64% of revenue) and continues to expand its technological capabilities and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ropeok emphasizes its unique value proposition of delivering AI core technologies integrated with deep industry knowledge to provide tailored, secure, and scalable AI+industry solutions. Its competitive differentiation lies in its comprehensive AI technology stack, including AI large models, AIoT platforms, and intelligent hardware, combined with strong R&D capabilities and extensive real-world application experience. The company focuses on solving critical customer pain points such as data security, model trustworthiness, and industry-specific AI adaptation, positioning itself as a trusted technology partner for digital transformation.
